rate_limits: 200 requests/s hard limit; 100 requests/s recommended; User-Agent required
resolution_notes: rate_limits: both verifiers correct that "not published" is wrong. Official MediaWiki REST API docs (https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Wikimedia_REST_API#Rate_limiting) state 200 req/s hard limit and 100 req/s recommended, with User-Agent required. Wikimedia API getting-started rate limits (https://api.wikimedia.org/wiki/Documentation/Getting_started/Rate_limits) describe a shared ~200 rps limit and polite-use/User-Agent requirements. Settled value merges both: hard 200/s, recommended 100/s, User-Agent required.
